patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports a 6-week history of tingling pain in the sole of his right foot, which worsens when he raises it above chest level during exercises. He mentions that he began exercising regularly 2 months ago and experiences right calf cramps with the use of the treadmill's incline feature, necessitating frequent breaks. The pain subsides completely after a few minutes of resting. He adds an 8-year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Smokes two packs of cigarettes daily for 34 years.
